permission_denials.command:
perl -i -pe 's/\e\[36m%d\e\[0m/\\u001b[36m%d\\u001b[0m/' journals/2026-08-25-intermittent-503s-chaos-failure-rate.md && grep -n 'color_message' journals/2026-08-25-intermittent-503s-chaos-failure-rate.md | cat -v && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, re, sys
try:
    import yaml
except ImportError:
    print("no yaml module"); sys.exit(2)
text = open("journals/2026-08-25-intermittent-503s-chaos-failure-rate.md").read()
m = re.match(r"^---\n(.*?)\n---\n", text, re.S)
core = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1))
schema = json.load(open(".claude/skills/investigate/journal.schema.json"))
try:
    import jsonschema
    jsonschema.Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(core)
    print("schema: OK")
except ImportError:
    print("no jsonschema module; shape not validated")
ids = {e["id"] for e in core["evidence"]}
refs = set()
for h in core["hypotheses"]:
    refs |= set(h["evidence_for"]) | set(h["evidence_against"])
for l in core.get("latent_findings", []):
    refs |= set(l["evidence"])
print("unresolved refs:", refs - ids)
print("unused evidence:", ids - refs)
from datetime import datetime
s = datetime.fromisoformat(core["investigation"]["started"].replace("Z","+00:00"))
c = datetime.fromisoformat(core["investigation"]["concluded"].replace("Z","+00:00"))
print("wall clock ok:", int((c-s).total_seconds()) == core["usage"]["wall_clock_seconds"])
rc = core["root_cause"]["hypothesis"]
print("root_cause validated:", any(h["id"]==rc and h["state"]=="validated" for h in core["hypotheses"]))
EOF
